summary: Retested the iter318 inventory project isolation fixes. Backend: 8 of 9 pytest tests pass, after I fixed one 500. GET /warehouse-purchase-requests is now isolated by X-Project-Id, and the ?status filter works. Sequence numbers are tenant-global for warehouse-purchase-requests, manufacturing-requests, warehouse-to-manufacturing transfer_number and PKG numbers. Cross-project PUT, add-stock and DELETE on a raw material, and DELETE on a packaging material, return 404 and leave the item unchanged. The same-project flow passes with no 404/500: add-stock, edit, warehouse→manufacturing, manufacturing request create and fulfill, product create and produce, branch request create and fulfill. Packaging-requests list and branch-packaging-inventory are isolated by project. Bug found and fixed: GET /api/packaging-requests in server.py returned 500 on every call. Its loop did r['id'] = r.pop('_id'), which put an ObjectId into the response. I changed it to project {'_id': 0}. The backend did not hot-reload this file, so I restarted it. Still open: the server.py packaging POST/transfer routes shadow the routes/inventory_system.py versions, and they drop from_branch_id (details below). Frontend: all 4 checks pass. The request-materials dialog shows the locked 'المشروع: مطعم الاختبار' field, and the sync-preview dialog code no longer has it. /reports/price-increases has the project bar and re-fetches with the new project_id when the project changes. The /warehouse project bar sits under the sticky header (header ends at y=85, bar starts at y=97). The MoveToProjectDialog target list excludes the current project.

critical.issue: The server.py route shadows routes/inventory_system.py. Its PackagingRequestCreate has no from_branch_id field, so an admin or any user without branch_id saves from_branch_id=None. The transfer then lowers main packaging stock (20→17 in the test) but adds nothing to any branch_packaging_inventory, so the stock disappears. The server.py version also returns a string request_number 'PKG-000N', while inventory_system returns an int, and GET ignores ?status.

minor.issue: FIXED by testing agent: 500 ObjectId serialization (r['id']=r.pop('_id')). Now uses {'_id':0}.
These use raw db, not the scoped db. Branch inventory inserted by transfer has no project_id tag; it is only visible through branch_id→project mapping.

issues: The page background is dark navy, but the PageProjectBar select trigger shows no visible text: white border, empty-looking value.
The header title is dark red and the back/refresh button text is dark, both on a dark background. Contrast is low.
The initial load fires GET /reports/price-increases twice (duplicate fetch).

action_items: Remove the duplicate server.py packaging-requests POST/approve/transfer routes (or add from_branch_id to their model) so the inventory_system.py versions, or a fixed copy, handle the request. Transfer must not lower main stock when no branch is set.
Fix contrast of the project select and header text on /reports/price-increases (dark theme).
critical_code_review_comments: The _ScopedCollection.find_one bypass for sorts on *_number keys is broad. If find_one is called with an id filter plus sort on a *_number field, it skips project scoping. Narrow the bypass to filter-less counter lookups.
_lenient lets any untagged (project_id null/empty) doc be updated or deleted from any project. This is fine after the backfill, but worth noting.
server.py still holds many duplicate inventory routes that shadow routes/inventory_system.py, so fixes in one file silently do nothing. Consolidate them.
seed_data_creation: TEST_i319* docs were created and then removed directly in MongoDB. The raw-material delete API returns 409 once a material has been used.
